items.translation: 查询的查找策略。

items.source: Querydsl specific fragment for extending SimpleNeo4jRepository with an implementation of QuerydslPredicateExecutor.
items.translation: 用于扩展 SimpleNeo4jRepository 的 Querydsl 特定片段，该扩展包含对 QuerydslPredicateExecutor 的实现。

items.source: Querydsl specific fragment for extending SimpleReactiveNeo4jRepository with an implementation of ReactiveQuerydslPredicateExecutor.
items.translation: 用于扩展 SimpleReactiveNeo4jRepository 的 QueryDSL 专用片段，该扩展包含 ReactiveQuerydslPredicateExecutor 的实现。

items.source: Imperative variant of the CypherdslConditionExecutor.
items.translation: CypherdslConditionExecutor的强制变体。

items.source: Specialized version of Query whose values is always used as exists projection.
items.translation: Query的专用版本，其值始终用作存在投影。

items.source: Implementation of the ReactiveCypherdslConditionExecutor.
items.translation: 实现ReactiveCypherdslConditionExecutor。

items.source: A set of annotations for providing custom queries to repositories.
items.translation: 用于向仓库提供自定义查询的一组注解。

items.source:
This package provides the Neo4j imperative and reactive
repository API.
items.translation: 该包提供了 Neo4j 命令式和响应式仓库 API。

items.source:
Configuration infrastructure for Neo4j specific repositories,
especially dedicated annotations to enable imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j
repositories.
items.translation: 为 Neo4j 专用仓库配置基础设施，特别是通过专用注解来启用命令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 仓库。

items.source:
This package provides a couple of public support classes for
building custom imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j repository base classes.
items.translation: 该包提供了一些公共支持类，用于构建自定义的指令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 仓库基类。

items.source:
This is a utility class that computes the bounding box of a polygon as a rectangle
defined by the lower left and upper right point.
items.translation: 这是一个工具类，用于计算多边形的边界框，该边界框由左下角和右上角点定义的矩形表示。

items.source: Bridging between Spring Data domain Objects and Cypher constructs.
items.translation: 在 Spring Data 领域对象与 Cypher 构造之间建立桥梁。

items.source: This class provides a couple of extensions to the Spring Data Neo4j SpEL support.
items.translation: 该类为 Spring Data Neo4j 的 SpEL 支持提供了一些扩展。

items.source:
A marker interface that indicates a literal replacement in a query instead of a
parameter replacement.
items.translation: 一个标记接口，用于指示在查询中进行字面替换而非参数替换。

items.source: The target of this replacement.
items.translation: 本次替换的目标。

items.source: Annotation to provide Cypher statements that will be used for executing the method.
items.translation: 注释，用于提供将用于执行该方法的 Cypher 语句。

items.source: Collects the parts of a Cypher query to be handed over to the Cypher generator.
items.translation: 收集要传递给 Cypher 生成器的 Cypher 查询的各个部分。

items.source: Combines the QueryFragments with parameters.
items.translation: 将查询片段与参数组合。

items.source: A fragment for repositories providing "Query by example" functionality.
items.translation: 为提供“示例查询”功能的仓库提供的片段。

items.source:
A fragment for repositories providing "Query by example" functionality in a reactive
way.
items.translation: 为以响应式方式提供“示例查询”功能的仓库提供一个片段。

items.source: Indicates a vector search on a repository.
items.translation: 表示对仓库执行向量搜索。

items.source: Collected params for vector search.
items.translation: 已收集向量搜索的参数。
